title: A Study of Tirzepatide (LY3298176) in Participants With Obesity or Overweight
headline: Tirzepatide, Placebo reduced percent change from baseline in body weight (prima by 20.1
summary: Researchers randomly assigned 1260 ages 18 Years and older, with Overweight, Obesity to receive either Tirzepatide, Placebo or a placebo. Those receiving the treatment had lower percent change from baseline in body weight (primary treatment period) on average. This is strong evidence because participants were randomly assigned to groups. (LS Mean Difference (Net): -20.1, p<0.001)
population: ages 18 Years and older, with Overweight, Obesity
outcome_name: Percent Change From Baseline in Body Weight (Primary Treatment Period)
